archetypes.name: shard-wiring
archetypes.rationale: The plan threads test-trailer-awk.sh as invoke-only through test-trailer-helpers.sh into shard test-harnesses-12 with no new Makefile target; verify the existing thin-adapter precedent and shard-coverage check won't reject this approach.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine whether the plan's 'invoke-only harness, no standalone Makefile target' claim is backed by repo evidence. Check the existing thin CLI adapters (test-trailer-dedup.sh, test-trailer-has-any.sh, test-trailer-validate.sh) to confirm they are truly invoke-only and that the shard registry for test-harnesses-12 does not require a 1:1 target-to-harness mapping. Verify whether a shard-coverage check (e.g. make test-harness-shards-coverage) exists in the Makefile that would reject an invoke-only harness, and confirm the plan's mitigation is sufficient. Trace the full invocation chain (Makefile → test-harnesses-12 shard → test-trailer-helpers.sh → test-trailer-awk.sh) and flag any missing intermediate link not addressed in the plan. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: resolution-evidence
archetypes.rationale: The plan declares Claim #1 (Gate A/B trailer-guard wiring) already resolved by citing specific file sections and line numbers; verify those citations are accurate and the tightening proposed for approval-gates.md and discussion-rounds.md is correctly scoped with no unguarded ACTION=EMIT_PLAN paths remaining.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify the plan's assertion that Gate A/B trailer-guard wiring is already resolved. Check that skills/design/SKILL.md (Gate A re-entry and Gate B post-apply paths), skills/design/references/approval-gates.md (shared post-apply pipeline section), and skills/design/references/discussion-rounds.md (post-plan sub-round) each actually contain gate-b-dedup-plan.sh --snapshot-trailers and --dedup invocations before any ACTION=EMIT_PLAN. Confirm that lines 397-402 of scripts/test-design-structure.sh are already strong literal pins for SKILL_MD and that lines 403-408 are the weak 'snapshot' substring checks the plan intends to tighten for APPROVAL_MD and DISCUSSION_MD. Assess whether any additional ACTION=EMIT_PLAN surface exists beyond those three files that the plan's tightening does not cover. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
